channel.description:
Nature Communications is an open access, multidisciplinary journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in all areas of the biological, health, physical, chemical and Earth sciences. Papers published by the journal aim to represent important advances of significance to specialists within each field.

We are committed to providing an efficient service for both authors and readers. Our team of independent editors make rapid and fair publication decisions. Prompt dissemination of accepted papers to a wide readership and beyond is achieved through a programme of continuous online publication.

item.title: [6] Electrically driven inverse metamagnetic transition in Sm1-xSrxMnO3
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Mark Blamire, Bhagwati Prasad

Authors: Suryakanta Mondal, Vinod Kumar, Sourav Chowdhury, et al.

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Study of correlated oxide phase transitions relevant to electronic structure interests.

Tags: #correlatedoxides #magnetism

Abstract: Correlated oxides are known to exhibit metamagnetic switching from a non-ferromagnetic to ferromagnetic phase. Here, the authors demonstrate an electrically driven inverse-metamagnetic transition from a ferromagnetic state to an antiferromagnetic-like phase in an epitaxial Sm1-xSrxMnO3 thin film.
